last_experiment.hypothesis: A causal cross-sectional residual-strength engine with regime-aware asymmetric long/short routing and inverse-vol sizing can produce robust alpha without inheriting prior engine strategy logic.
last_experiment.decision_basis: economic hypothesis defined before any V98 result exists

research_protocol: Read and diagnose the prior V98 experiment before proposing the next one.
Use training and chronological folds for research decisions; holdout is validation only.
Do not use V99 for tuning or parameter selection.
Reject cosmetic improvements and robustness-destroying return gains.
Do not repeat failed concepts under renamed parameters.
Evaluate base, severe and supersevere costs plus funding stress.
Record failure mechanism before changing architecture.
notification_policy: silent unless final pass or blocker requiring user intervention
